metadata.name: Kimono Music
metadata.description: Play any song, with its lyrics, and find more you'll like.

configuration.label: Last.fm API key
configuration.description: From last.fm/api/account/create (no callback URL needed). Finds songs like the one playing and learns genres. Music works without it.

configuration.label: Spotify client ID
configuration.description: From developer.spotify.com/dashboard. Redirect URI: <portal>/api/v1/music/connect/spotify/callback. Lets people bring in their private playlists and Liked Songs.

configuration.label: Google client ID
configuration.description: A web OAuth client in Google Cloud, with the YouTube Data API on. Redirect URI: <portal>/api/v1/music/connect/youtube/callback.

configuration.label: Apple team ID
configuration.description: Your Apple Developer team, for Apple Music library playlists.

configuration.label: Apple MusicKit key ID
configuration.description: A key with MusicKit on, from Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles.
